title: Model Gap Heuristic & Provisioning Playbook (Market Probe)
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Goal: produce an actionable playbook that (1) codifies a lightweight heuristic for identifying 'model gaps' in our customers' workloads, (2) maps those gaps to provisioning responses (hosted/quant/dedicated/private), and (3) operationalizes a continuous market-probe to keep the heuristic calibrated.

Scope and deliverables:
- Heuristic definition doc: signal inputs (latency tolerance, budget sensitivity, token distribution, embedding density, hallucination risk) and scoring rules.
- Provisioning decision matrix: recommended action per score band (e.g., scale dedicated vs. promote quantized variant vs. on-prem pilot).
- Scout instrumentation spec: minimal telemetry to detect supply-side risk (model availability, latency degradation, price variance) and demand-side changes (query mix shifts, sequence length spikes).
- Runbook for triage and procurement triggers: who acts, SLA for response, fallback mapping, and customer communication templates.
- Prototype dashboard wireframe for Console: aggregated gap score, top affected customers, suggested mitigations.

Approach and assumptions:
- Prioritize signals that correlate with real customer outages (latency spikes, sustained error rate, sudden cost deltas).
- Use a mixed-methods probe: combine quantitative telemetry (from Console metrics) with qualitative field interviews (customer success + sales feedback).
- Treat the heuristic as probabilistic; include confidence bands and a 'manual review' gate for high-impact actions.

Success metrics:
- Precision of heuristic in identifying incidents that required a provisioning action (>70% in pilot).
- Mean time to mitigate a detected supply issue using the playbook (target <24h).
- Number of potential high-impact customers surfaced per week by the probe (baseline >3).

Stakeholders and reviewers:

- Example procurement template PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/procurement/pull/77

Trade-offs discussed so far:
- Aggressive automated fallbacks reduce customer-facing outages but increase provisioning churn and cost; we will add a manual review step for any action that could exceed a weekly budget threshold.
- Broad telemetry increases signal quality but raises retention/cost concerns; initial probe will use 30-day retention and roll forward to longer retention only if ROI justifies it.

Next steps:
- Complete draft heuristic and share with Eng for simulation (due 2026-03-20).
- Run a 3-week retrospective pilot against historical incidents (owner: Liam).
- Build Wireframe -> UX review with Console PM (prereq for prototype Q2 roadmap).
